_help: Site-wide settings. apiBase: "" = forms post to Zoho (or ask visitors to email), "mock" = demo backend in the browser (bookings + CRM at /admin/, data stays in that browser; refused in production builds), a URL = the real booking API.
summary: Pferdegestütztes Coaching für Kinder und Erwachsene in Winterthur (Schweiz) mit Manuela Pattynama: Einzelcoaching, Reitpädagogik, Kids Camps, Wingwave und Epigenetik. Angebote auf Deutsch.

zoho._help: Bridge until our own booking API exists (apiBase empty). Copy 'action' and the hidden inputs (xnQsjsdp, xmIwtLD, actionType, zc_gad …) from the old site's Zoho webform HTML. 'fields' maps our form fields to Zoho field names; everything else goes into descriptionField. Leave 'action' empty to switch a form off.
